note: FNS 726.2 provides QC review charts (Charts 1-4) that walk federal auditors through a multi-month income comparison process to determine whether a Simplified Reporting household had an unreported required income change. The charts describe comparing unconverted sample-month income to the SR 130% reporting threshold, then stepping back through prior months and considering NOAA periods — all QC audit methodology with no caseworker equivalent. The underlying SR policy (households must report when gross income exceeds 130% FPL for their size) is well-covered in the OLG across multiple pages including 'Simplified Reporting – Reporting Requirements During Case Maintenance', 'Simplified Reporting – Overview', and 'Simplified Reporting – Examples'. No OLG coverage of these QC review charts is needed or expected.
